entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ValidateNever attribute seems to be ignored #64785
  • blazor big project: build perf downgrade #64784
  • Blazor WASM: DateTime.MinValue not usable for comparison once page loaded in WASM #64783
  • Perf improvement: updates #64780
  • Consider adding AsyncAPI to SignalR #64777
  • Regression: CSS isolation not applying all styles in Blazor Server .NET 10 #64776
  • Add Forbidden and Forbidden<T> HttpResults like Ok/NotFound/Conflict and others #64775

Closed

  • Suggestion for a @renderkey in Blazor's Razor syntax #64764
  • [OpenAPI] Trailing slash in servers.url when generating OpenAPI spec #64702
  • Default AutoComplete component #63960
    Backlog
  • My component dont work when packaged #64759
  • Blazor WebAssembly DevServer fails to use development HTTPS certificate after NuGet package upgrade #64731
  • Allow the interception of property injection with Blazor Components #28957
    Backlog
  • [Blazor] Introduce a public abstraction for property injection #63451
    Backlog
  • Support hosted services in WebAssemblyHost #63637
    Backlog
  • .NET 10 Blazor WASM hang #64765
  • Regression: CSS isolation not applying all styles in Blazor Server .NET 10 #64641
  • Not all css is being recognized in isolation #64642
